advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0367: ZIP extraction advisory; the archive viewer and single-entry reader never call extract, and entry bytes are written to a self-named temp file so archive permission bits are never applied.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0368: ZIP symlink-escape advisory scoped to ZipArchive::extract, which Telegram Drive never calls; the updater only takes that path for ZIP payloads and the release manifest serves NSIS installers.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0369: ZIP permission-through-symlink advisory scoped to extract()/extract_unchecked(); nothing in the graph extracts archives onto disk, and the zip 9 upgrade is blocked on the Tauri updater plugin.
